Surgical resection included approximately 15 cm of small bowel and 13 lymph nodes, with no liver lesions observed. Histopathological examination confirmed a well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor (Grade 1, Ki-67 <1%) with metastasis to 1 of 13 lymph nodes (N1), clear surgical margins, and T3 staging per final diagnosis. Post-operative course was complicated by ileus that resolved with conservative management.
